BiblicalUsage: The word is the fig tree. Adam and Eve sewed fig leaves together after their eyes were opened; Micah says every man shall sit under his vine and under his fig tree, and none shall make them afraid; and Habakkuk says, Although the fig tree shall not blossom, yet I will rejoice in the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fig tree runs through the whole story, from the first cover-up to the prophet's joy without a harvest.
